result.reason: The operative clause includes all preferred coverages and limits, the data-processing condition for cyber coverage, legally required workers’ compensation, and certificates upon request. However, it goes beyond the playbook by requiring all coverage—including CGL and workers’ compensation—for one year after termination and by adding an at-own-expense requirement. The section numbering is also presented out of sequence (14.11 before 14.10), which reduces drafting quality. The existing bankruptcy and integration provisions are otherwise substantively preserved; the margin comment does not cure or affect the operative drafting.
